{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent upward price momentum when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00).",
    "Apply a lag correction: if true outcome is significantly higher than forecast, reduce forecast by 5-10% for the next period to avoid overshoot.",
    "Implement mean reversion bias: if forecast consistently exceeds true outcome by >10% over 3 consecutive periods, reduce forecast by 5-15% in next period.",
    "For high sentiment (sentiment > 0.50), reduce forecast by 5-10% to avoid overreaction to bullish signals.",
    "For low sentiment (sentiment < -0.50), increase forecast by 5-10% to counteract bearish bias.",
    "When true outcome spikes >15% above forecast, apply a 10-20% downward correction in next period to prevent overcorrection."
  ]
}
